messages.text:
"Create a complete playable 2D medieval strategy game called EMPIRE WARS, inspired by classic Zynga Facebook strategy games.

PLATFORM:
- HTML5 web game.
- Compatible with Android phones and computers.
- Landscape and portrait screen support.
- Smooth touchscreen and mouse controls.
- Colorful 2D graphics.

MAIN GAMEPLAY:

1. VILLAGE BUILDING
- Start with a small village.
- Build farms, houses, barracks, castles and defense towers.
- Upgrade every building.
- Expand your village.

2. RESOURCE SYSTEM
- Collect gold, wood, food and stone.
- Farms produce food automatically.
- Buildings generate resources over time.
- Use resources to construct and upgrade buildings.

3. ARMY SYSTEM
- Recruit warriors, archers, knights, swordsmen and cavalry.
- Train soldiers.
- Every soldier has individual statistics.
- Soldiers gain experience and level up.
- Upgrade weapons, armor and abilities.

4. WAR SYSTEM
- Attack enemy villages.
- Defend your own village.
- Create real-time 2D animated battles.
- Soldiers automatically fight enemies.
- Different units have different strengths and abilities.
- Show battle results, victories and rewards.

5. ENEMY SYSTEM
- Create intelligent computer-controlled enemy villages.
- Enemies collect resources and build armies.
- Enemies can attack the player's village.
- Increase enemy difficulty as the player progresses.

6. PLAYER PROGRESSION
- Player levels from 1 to 100.
- Daily missions.
- Achievements.
- Rewards and rare equipment.
- Unlock new buildings and soldiers.

7. GAME INTERFACE
- Main village screen.
- Building menu.
- Army recruitment menu.
- Resource display.
- Battle screen.
- Upgrade screen.
- Settings menu.
- Turkish language support.

8. SAVE SYSTEM
- Automatically save player progress.
- Remember buildings, resources, soldiers and levels.
- Use browser local storage for saving.

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS:
- Create an actual playable game, not just a menu or static image.
- All buttons must work.
- All buildings must be functional.
- Soldiers must be recruitable and upgradeable.
- Battles must actually work.
- Resources must increase and decrease correctly.
- Make the game attractive and easy to play.
- Do not use placeholder buttons.
- Do not create fake multiplayer features.
- Prioritize a fully working single-player game.

FUTURE EXPANSION:
Design the game architecture so real online multiplayer, player accounts, alliances, trading and PvP battles can be added later.

Build the playable game now.
"
